channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: McGeeney vows to stop talking about referees
item.description: Kieran McGeeney has claimed that some journalists are 'infatuated' by him.

item.title: Munster GAA announce championship double headers with camogie and ladies football
item.description: Munster GAA have partnered with Munster Camogie and Munster Ladies Football once again to provide curtain-raisers for some of their Munster SHC and SFC games.

item.title: 'He's the type of superstar Mayo really need'
item.description: Ciarán Whelan has described Kobe McDonald's senior debut for Mayo as 'phenomenal'.

item.title: The late Liam Kearns honoured by An Garda Síochána
item.description: Liam Kearns has been posthumously inducted into the An Garda Síochána Coiste Siamsa Hall of Fame.

item.title: 'I don't see quality forwards coming through in Kilkenny'
item.description: Liam Sheedy reckons Kilkenny are lacking the firepower needed to win an All-Ireland SHC title.

item.title: Dublin GAA's Spawell facility gets go-ahead
item.description: Dublin GAA has been granted planning permission to develop a new state-of-the-art training facility in Spawell.

item.title: Higgins: enjoy Kobe mania while it lasts
item.description: Keith Higgins has urged Mayo fans to enjoying watching Kobe McDonald before he moves to the AFL later this year.

item.title: Maguire facing two-match ban
item.description: Cork captain Ian Maguire is contesting a proposed two-match ban arising from his sending off against Meath last Sunday.

item.title: Bourke looking for Kerry to bounce back
item.description: Kerry manager Mark Bourke is hopeful his charges can bounce back from their double scores loss to neighbours Cork.

item.title: Wet weather forces Westmeath footballers to train in Leitrim
item.description: The Westmeath senior footballers were forced to train in Leitrim last week due to the unavailability of playable pitches in their own county.
